# BisherTalks

> Official website of Bisher KC — Indian life coach, corporate trainer, and
> author of the self-help psychology book **Neuro Code** (ന്യൂറോ കോഡ്). The site
> sells the book and hosts his free NLP video courses.

## Key facts

- **Neuro Code** is a self-help book about rewriting your mental programming
  using NLP (Neuro-Linguistic Programming) and behavioural psychology.
- Written by Bisher KC, life coach and NLP trainer, CEO of Skillage (Kerala, India).
- Available in Malayalam and English.
- Every copy includes **free lifetime access to the NLP Mastery video course**:
  14 modules, 42 video lessons, 17 downloadable practice worksheets (₹2,499 value).
- The course covers: NLP filters, mental maps, representational systems (VAKOG),
  anchoring, sub-modalities, belief-system reprogramming, reframing, outcome
  setting, visualization, affirmation, and modelling.
- Orders ship across India with free delivery, typically arriving in 5–7
  business days, with WhatsApp updates and order tracking.
- Current price and ordering: https://bishertalks.com/neuro-code

## Pages

- [Neuro Code — the book](https://bishertalks.com/neuro-code): what the book
  covers, reader reviews, FAQ, and ordering.
- [Free courses](https://bishertalks.com/courses): NLP and personal-development
  courses by Bisher KC; module lists are public, lessons unlock with a book order.
- [About Bisher KC](https://bishertalks.com/): life coaching, corporate
  training, and speaking.
